name: com.texcontractor/texcontractor
title: TexContractor
description: Find local home-service pros (plumbers, AC, handymen and more) and post jobs. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: find_local_pros
tools.description: Find independent home-service pros (plumbers, AC/heating, electricians, handymen, roofers, mobile mechanics, cleaners, babysitters and more) listed on TexContractor in a US city. Returns names, service, city and a profile link where the homeowner can see work photos and text the pro directly. Free for homeowners, no lead fees for pros.

service.description: What the person needs, e.g. 'plumber', 'AC repair', 'garage door repair', 'handyman'

tools.name: post_job_request
tools.description: Returns a TexContractor link where the homeowner posts their job (description, city, photos) so nearby pros contact them. Set urgent=true for BOOM: the job is sent straight to pros near them right away and stays open 24 hours. The homeowner signs in with their phone; nothing is posted until they confirm.

urgent.description: true if they need help today

tools.name: list_open_job_requests
tools.description: For contractors and pros: open job requests that homeowners posted on TexContractor, optionally filtered by state, city or service. Pros list their service free to send offers. No lead fees.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: All home-service categories that have pros listed on TexContractor.
